title: Automate changelog and onboard Morpheus-14b v1.0 (perf metadata + profiles)
author: Sana Patel
description: Onboard Morpheus-14b v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, performance profiles for common serving configs, and automation to generate changelog/release notes for model onboarding and perf updates. This PR adds model metadata (card + tags), a set of performance profiles derived from our perf-lab runs (batch sizes, seq lengths, latency/throughput targets), and a GitHub Action + helper script to build changelog entries automatically when model metadata or perf profiles change. Motivation: reduce manual steps when adding models, ensure consistent release notes, and allow downstream consumers (console, docs, CLI) to display vetted perf characteristics. The description below includes summary of commits, changed files, review discussion, CI runs, and merge details.
commits: Add morpheus-14b v1.0 metadata and model card
Add performance profiles (latency/throughput baselines) for typical serving configs
Add generate_changelog.py and GH Action workflow to auto-create changelog entries
Integrate perf profile schema validation into registry ingestion
Add unit and integration tests for new fields and changelog output
perf_summary: KV-cache warmup: effective tokens/s improvement ~1.9x vs cold start
